layoffHelp: Select one hand card, then press "Lay off" on a table meld
turnPhase: Your turn. Draw or play a meld

hint.newMeld: You can form a valid meld from your hand. Select the cards and press "New meld"
hint.layoff: You can lay a card off onto a table meld
hint.draw: No play available. Draw a card from the stock

tutorial.table: This is the shared table. Melds laid here can be freely rearranged by everyone.
tutorial.playerHand: This is your 13-card hand. Form sets or runs of 3 or more cards.
tutorial.drawButton: Draw one card from the stock when you have no play (ends your turn).
tutorial.newMeldButton: Select 3 or more hand cards to lay a new meld on the table.
tutorial.scoreTable: Player scores are shown here. Lowest cumulative total wins.
tutorial.resetButton: Press the reset button to start a new game.

rearrange.title: Rearrange table
rearrange.help: Break up table melds and recombine them with your hand. Assign each card to a target group. You can submit only when every group is a valid meld.
rearrange.selectPrompt: Select one or more hand cards to start rearranging
rearrange.statusMelds: Make every group a valid meld (a set or run of 3+ cards)
rearrange.statusConserve: Assign every card to a group (some are still unassigned)
rearrange.statusPlay: You must play at least one card from your hand
